lab.intro: Compare three or more groups of texts by the features of a layer. Exploratory results.
lab.method.anova.explain: Kruskal-Wallis per feature, with epsilon² (0.01 small; 0.08 medium; 0.26 large) and corrected p.
lab.method.dendrogram.explain: Clusters the groups' mean profiles: who resembles whom.
lab.method.nearest.explain: The first group against each of the others: which one it is closest to, and on which features it departs.
lab.method.one_vs_rest.explain: Cohen's d of each group against all others together: what sets each group apart.
lab.method.pairwise.explain: Cohen's d for each pair of groups; the matrix shows mean |d| (larger = farther apart).
lab.method.profile.explain: Each text is a point (PCA of the features), coloured by group.
